note: Synthetic figures computed from fixtures/acme/data by fixtures/acme/reference-figures.ts. Money is in US dollars.

figures.name: revenue_2025
figures.definition: Sum of fct_orders.amount_cents / 100 for orders created in 2025 (UTC) with status completed or shipped, excluding orders by test accounts (dim_customers.is_test_account is true, or the email ends in @example-test.com). Orders whose customer_id has no row in dim_customers count. Shipping is not revenue.

figures.name: order_count_2025
figures.definition: Number of orders that count toward revenue_2025, by the same rule.

figures.name: average_order_value_2025
figures.definition: revenue_2025 divided by order_count_2025, rounded to the cent.

figures.name: revenue_by_region_2025
figures.definition: revenue_2025 split by fct_orders.ship_region (the region the order shipped to, which is the sales region), joined to dim_regions for the name.

figures.name: refunds_on_2025_orders
figures.definition: Sum of fct_refunds.refunded_cents / 100 over refunds of the orders counted in revenue_2025, whenever the refund was issued.

figures.name: net_revenue_2025
figures.definition: revenue_2025 minus refunds_on_2025_orders. Refunds of orders with status refunded are not subtracted, because those orders are already outside revenue.

figures.name: sessions_2025
figures.definition: Number of rows in lake sessions with started_at in 2025 (UTC), anonymous sessions included.

figures.name: converted_sessions_2025
figures.definition: Sessions in 2025 with a non-null customer_id whose customer placed an order counted in revenue on the same UTC date as the session started.

figures.name: conversion_rate_2025
figures.definition: converted_sessions_2025 divided by sessions_2025, rounded to four decimals.

figures.name: marketing_spend_by_channel_2025
figures.definition: Sum of marketing_spend.spend_cents / 100 for spend_date in 2025, by channel.

figures.name: new_customers_2025
figures.definition: Customers in dim_customers whose first order counted in revenue (any year) was created in 2025.

figures.name: blended_cac_2025
figures.definition: marketing_spend_2025 divided by new_customers_2025, rounded to the cent.

common_mistakes.name: revenue_2025_all_statuses
common_mistakes.definition: Revenue with cancelled and refunded orders left in.

common_mistakes.name: revenue_2025_flag_only
common_mistakes.definition: Revenue excluding is_test_account but not the example-test.com emails.

common_mistakes.name: revenue_2025_inner_join
common_mistakes.definition: Revenue with an inner join to dim_customers, which drops orders whose customer is missing.

common_mistakes.name: refunds_issued_in_2025
common_mistakes.definition: All refunds issued in 2025, including refunds of refunded orders, which double-count against revenue.
